scope: Independent integrity and checkpoint audit; no training or evaluation performed. This JSON is the only artifact written.

candidate_training_repair.scope: explicit initial curriculum training startup only
candidate_training_repair.dead_detection: input weight, input bias, output weight are exactly zero

output_preservation.guarantee: Output weight remains exactly zero and output bias is unchanged; the candidate head output equals its existing output bias for all finite inputs. Other model tensors are not modified.

tensor_comparison_method: Compare dtype, shape, and contiguous CPU tensor raw bytes via uint8. Numeric difference summaries are separate from bitwise freeze checks.
limitations: Parameter updates and frozen tensor preservation do not establish improved task success or generalization.
Checkpoint snapshots verify stored iteration endpoints, not intermediate optimizer states.
HEUR superiority must be established separately with paired held-out evaluation.
